title: Ordre de Cendre — pièces vectorielles de production

provenance.author: OpenAI assistant, original code and geometry for Darknigthmare
provenance.method: Authored vector geometry. No image generation, stock images, traced references or third-party artwork.
provenance.rights: Original project assets; no third-party sample or art dependencies.
provenance.prompt: Produire les lots À produire avec pièces, pivots et silhouettes originales intégrables au style Canvas existant.

units: 1 local vector unit = 1 game-world unit; x/y is a named mechanical pivot. Nominal size is distinct from ink bounds.
constraints: Feet and hitboxes remain simulation-owned. These drawings introduce no collisions or playable chassis.
Only six canon chassis are playable; the six additional silhouettes are concept work.
No prepainted passengers, staff, survivors, evidence or readable records in wrecks.
Common-scale authoring sheets are not screenshots of gameplay or browser validation.
SVG and Canvas consume the same shapes. Human animation, in-game motion, lighting and final art approval remain separate.
